Hi there! If your bank transfer has cleared on your side but hasn't been applied to your Meridian account, our billing team can trace it. Please send them the transfer date, amount, and the reference you used. With those details they can match the incoming transfer to the correct account and invoice and apply the payment.

If you need the contact details for the billing team, let us know and we’ll provide them.
